description: Environment setup - verify existing build, tests, and typecheck pass on the current codebase before making any changes
steps: Run cd frontend && npm install to ensure dependencies are installed
Run cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compilation
Run cd frontend && npm run test -- --run to verify all 320 tests pass
Run cd frontend && npm run build to verify production build succeeds
acceptance_criteria: tsc --noEmit passes with no type errors
vite build produces dist/ folder without errors
findings: All baseline checks pass. npm install: up to date (381 packages). tsc --noEmit: clean. Tests: 320/320 pass (19 test files, 5.08s). Build: vite produces dist/ (803KB JS bundle). Note: NODE_OPTIONS must be unset to avoid proxy-bootstrap.js MODULE_NOT_FOUND error in this sandbox environment. React act() warnings present in some tests but all pass.
